fields.mechanism: Diagnostic challenges due to acoustic shadowing on echocardiography
fields.intervention: Implement multimodality imaging integration (TEE, cardiac CT, [18F]-FDG PET/CT) into the heart valve prosthesis monitoring protocol
fields.expected_effect: Improved diagnostic accuracy for prosthetic valve endocarditis through comprehensive imaging assessment
fields.falsification_test: Compare diagnostic accuracy using standard echocardiography alone versus multimodality imaging approach in detecting endocarditis in heart valve prosthesis patients
fields.mechanism_source_span: Diagnosis is often complex due to acoustic shadowing on echocardiography, making multimodality imaging with transesophageal echocardiography, cardiac computed tomography, and [18F]-FDG PET/CT essential.

fields.mechanism: Valve's reliance on radial fixation creates mechanical instability during prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE)
fields.intervention: Incorporate a secondary fixation mechanism independent of radial forces to maintain structural integrity during infection events
fields.expected_effect: Maintain device function and stability during PVE without requiring early surgical intervention
fields.falsification_test: Compare mechanical stability of modified valve versus standard Perceval valve under simulated infection conditions with radial force testing
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Management follows general PVE principles but often requires early surgical intervention because of the valve's reliance on radial fixation."

fields.mechanism: Acoustic shadowing on echocardiography complicating diagnosis of prosthetic valve endocarditis
fields.intervention: Incorporate multimodality imaging compatibility features into heart valve prosthesis design to minimize diagnostic shadowing effects
fields.expected_effect: Improved diagnostic accuracy for prosthetic valve endocarditis through enhanced imaging capabilities without compromising valve function
fields.falsification_test: Compare diagnostic accuracy of modified valve design versus standard design using transesophageal echocardiography in controlled porcine model with induced endocarditis
fields.mechanism_source_span: Diagnosis is often complex due to acoustic shadowing on echocardiography, making multimodality imaging with transesophageal echocardiography, cardiac computed tomography, and [18F]-FDG PET/CT essential.

fields.mechanism: Diagnostic challenges due to acoustic shadowing on echocardiography in Perceval sutureless valves
fields.intervention: Integration of multimodality imaging guidance system with real-time acoustic shadow compensation algorithms
fields.expected_effect: Improved diagnostic accuracy for prosthetic valve endocarditis without invasive interventions
fields.falsification_test: Compare diagnostic accuracy using standard echocardiography versus the enhanced system in a controlled phantom study simulating Perceval valve implants
fields.mechanism_source_span: Diagnosis is often complex due to acoustic shadowing on echocardiography, making multimodality imaging with transesophageal echocardiography, cardiac computed tomography, and [18F]-FDG PET/CT essential.

fields.mechanism: Radial fixation mechanism that maintains valve function under infection conditions without introducing new failure modes
fields.intervention: Implement a hybrid fixation system combining radial fixation with supplemental anchoring points to prevent mechanical instability during infective endocarditis
fields.expected_effect: Maintain valve structural integrity and hemodynamic performance during infection events while reducing the incidence of perivalvular extension and early mechanical instability
fields.falsification_test: In vitro mechanical testing under simulated infection conditions comparing conventional radial fixation against hybrid fixation system, measuring structural integrity and hemodynamic performance degradation
fields.mechanism_source_span: "but perivalvular extension and early mechanical instability are frequent. Management follows general PVE principles but often requires early surgical intervention because of the valve's reliance on radial fixation."
